Michigan at Ohio State
The Michigan Wolverines (6-5, 3-5 Big Ten) and the No. 21 Ohio State Buckeyes (7-4, 5-3 Big Ten) meet at Ohio Stadium. Michigan broke a two-game skid with a 18-16 triple overtime victory against UCLA, while Ohio State fell to Nebraska 31-28.

title: College Football

The Cincinnati Bearcats visit the No. 10 BYU Cougars for an NCAA Division I FBS conference game. The Cincinnati Bearcats defeated the Colorado Buffaloes 35-28 with JC French IV, while the BYU Cougars ride a two-game win streak with Bear Bachmeier.

title: Women's College Basketball

The undefeated No. 5 Blue Devils (6-0) face the No. 7 Huskies (4-3) in the Bad Boy Mowers Series at TD Garden. Duke seeks a seventh straight win after beating Columbia 71-47, while UConn looks to rebound from a 65-56 loss to South Carolina.

title: College Football

The Arizona State Sun Devils (6-5, 4-4 Big 12) battle the No. 16 Arizona Wildcats (8-3, 5-3 Big 12) at Casino Del Sol Stadium. Arizona State broke a two-game win streak with a 30-27 loss to Oklahoma State, while Arizona defeated Kansas State 35-28.
